BEFORE YOU BEGIN

Good questions.
Clear answers.

How do I get started?

Create an account or sign in from My account to manage your saved request drafts. Select “Submit a sample”, add your contact email and sample details, then choose Account or This device when saving. Saving a draft does not submit a request to the laboratory.

How do I verify a certificate of analysis?

Enter the Lookup Code shown on the certificate to open its report. Report and submission numbers are separate identifiers.

What if I've lost my Lookup Code?

Open Nova Support and prepare a report recovery request using the email used for testing and your company or project name. Additional verification may be needed before a report is shared.

What should I send to the laboratory?

Sample quantity, packaging, shipping conditions, and documentation depend on the requested analysis. These requirements should be confirmed with the laboratory before shipping.

Where can I see pricing and turnaround?

Confirm pricing and turnaround with the laboratory for your analysis. Saving a request draft does not collect a payment.

Report a problem

For a website issue or a question about a COA, include the page address, a brief description, and the Lookup Code if relevant.

A METHOD FOR YOUR QUESTION

Two perspectives.
One clearer picture.

01 / HPLC

Purity analysis

High-performance liquid chromatography separates detectable components in a sample. The resulting profile supports a closer look at relative purity under the selected method.

Report includes
A chromatogram and relative peak-area results.
Typical turnaround
~1 week
Before shipping
Confirm sample quantity and packaging with the laboratory.

02 / LC–MS

Identity confirmation

Liquid chromatography–mass spectrometry combines separation with mass information to help assess whether the observed signals are consistent with the expected analyte.

Report includes
Mass information assessed alongside the expected analyte.
Typical turnaround
~1 week
Before shipping
Confirm sample quantity and packaging with the laboratory.

03 / HPLC + LC–MS

Comprehensive panel

Bring purity analysis and identity confirmation together for a more complete analytical view.

  • Purity analysis · HPLC
  • Identity confirmation · LC–MS
